## 2. Build cache: one agent run's build sequence

### build/bench/c10_dds_sine (small: 1.2k LUT)

| call | until | cache | wall s (measured, with cache) | wall s without cache (modelled) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | synth | fresh | 82.8 | 81.5 |
| 2 | synth | hit | 0.3 | 81.5 |
| 3 | route | resume_synth | 74.8 | 138.0 |
| 4 | route | hit | 0.3 | 138.0 |
| 5 | route | hit | 0.3 | 138.0 |
| 6 | route | hit | 0.3 | 138.0 |
| 7 | bitstream | resume_route | 48.7 | 165.2 |
| total | | | **207.5** | **880.2** |

Saved: 672.7 s of 880.2 s (76%). The final (resumed) build's placement/routing hashes and WNS match the fresh 4-thread build c10_t4_a (('5f02911c315b', 'cfcaa990eb10') vs ('5f02911c315b', 'cfcaa990eb10'), WNS 3.259 vs 3.259). Gates of the final build: pass.

Model: a fresh build stopped at synth costs the fresh full build's time to `synth_reports` plus its start-up and runner overhead (6.0 s: wall time minus the last stage timestamp); stopped at route, its time to `reports` plus the same; to the bitstream, its measured wall time.

| t1_base | fresh | 153 | 2b3768b150c5 | f3765738e3be | 3.911 | none |
| t1_ila_resumed | resume_synth | 288 | bb7f8311ef40 | 240529c2a73a | 3.338 | exceptions_clean |

`exceptions_clean` fails on both ILA builds alike: the ILA core's own timing exceptions are reported as ignored (non-existent path). It is a property of the ILA variant on main, not of the resume.
